description: oeg-upm/gtfs-bench: v1.3.2 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Freddy Priyatna, David Chaves (Universidade de Santiago de Compostela). New version of the GTFS ontology, solving #143 and including controlled vocabularies. Thanks to @carlacastedo Mappings are now translated from YARRRML to [R2]RML with Yatter to improve their readability. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Apache-2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
